31. A disoriented man drives 3.25 km north, then 4.75 km west and finally 1.5 km south. Find the magnitude and direction of the resultant displacement, using the method of components. ( Ans: 5.06 km, 69.80 west of north)

34. A rocket fires two engines simultaneously. One produces a thrust of 725N directly forward and the other gives a 513N thrust at 32.40 above the forward direction. Find the magnitude and direction relative to the forward direction) of the resultant force which these engines exert on the rocket (Ans: 1190N, 13.40)

36. A spelunker is surveying a cave. She follows a passage 180 m straight west, then 210 m in a direction 450 east of south and then 280 m at 300 east of north. After a fourth unmeasured displacement, she finds herself back where she started. Determine the magnitude and direction of the fourth displacement. (Ans: 143.55 m, 40.900 south of west)
